plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Aruba switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, CPU 1/5-minute averages, memory utilization, temperature, fan status and RPM, power-supply status and watts, and interface traffic, for ArubaOS-CX and ArubaOS-Switch (enterprise PEN 47196).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU utilization of the Aruba device control plane (ARUBAWIRED per-module CPU utilization), normalized to a 0-100 percentage. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, routing instability, or attack traffic, and may lead to slow management response or packet processing delays.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports overall memory utilization of the Aruba device (ARUBAWIRED per-module memory utilization), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage. High memory usage may indicate memory leaks, oversized routing/MAC/ARP tables, or insufficient capacity, and can cause instability or failed allocations.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the temperature reading of each Aruba hardware sensor (ARUBAWIRED temperature sensor), in degrees Celsius. Abnormally high temperatures may indicate fan failure, blocked airflow, or excessive ambient heat, and can trigger thermal protection or hardware damage if left unaddressed.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of each Aruba cooling fan (arubaWiredFanStateEnum), normalized to 1 = normal (empty/ok), 2 = fault (uninitialized/fault), 3 = unknown (grey, does not alert). Only value 2 is treated as a cooling fault.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of each Aruba power supply unit (arubaWiredPSUStateEnum), normalized to 1 = normal (ok/empty), 2 = fault, 3 = unknown (grey, does not alert). Only value 2 is treated as a power-supply fault.

metrics.name: device_fan_rpm
metrics.description: Fan rotation speed in RPM from arubaWiredFanRPM, reported per fan. Values outside 0..100000 (including -1 no-readback) are dropped. A stalled fan reports 0 RPM.

metrics.name: aruba_psu_instantaneous_watts
metrics.description: Instantaneous output power of each Aruba CX power supply in watts (arubaWiredPSUInstantaneousPower). Values outside 0..100000 are dropped.

metrics.name: aruba_psu_maximum_watts
metrics.description: Nameplate maximum power of each Aruba CX power supply in watts (arubaWiredPSUMaximumPower). Values outside 0..100000 are dropped.

metrics.name: aruba_cpu_avg_1min
metrics.description: One-minute CPU utilization average of each Aruba CX module (arubaWiredSystemInfoCpuAvgOneMin), 0-100 percent. Values outside 0..100 are dropped.

metrics.name: aruba_cpu_avg_5min
metrics.description: Five-minute CPU utilization average of each Aruba CX module (arubaWiredSystemInfoCpuAvgFiveMin), 0-100 percent. Values outside 0..100 are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifInOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifOutOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
